remarks: Set on nearly two private acres and wrapped in nature, this storybook home feels like a retreat the moment you arrive. Spend quiet mornings on the 15' x 12' screened porch, unwind by the new gravel fire pit, or wander straight into the 179-acre Woodcock Nature Center-your own protected state park right in the backyard.  Inside, the home is filled with warmth and character: hardwood floors, Marvin windows, and newly updated bedroom and closet doors. The remodeled kitchen is a true highlight, featuring a farmhouse sink, SubZero refrigerator, Viking range, custom cabinetry, quartz counters, and a welcoming breakfast bar. The bathrooms have been tastefully updated, and the property offers plenty of space should you wish to add a pool.  With a septic system replaced just six years ago by Bill Dexter, this home is ready for its next chapter. Come experience it in person-you'll be glad you did. Please no drivebys; showings are by appointment only.
